template:
# 1. Sign in with your console identity (short-term credentials)
aws {{0}} --profile lantern-admin

# 2. Confirm which account and identity you are using
aws {{1}} get-caller-identity --profile lantern-admin

# 3. List bucket names only, as plain text, in Lantern's Region
aws s3api list-buckets --profile lantern-admin \
  --{{2}} eu-west-1 \
  --query "Buckets[].Name" --output {{3}}
